title: Rimavská Sobota Castle Fire
description:
In 1817, the historic **Rimavská Sobota Castle** was destroyed by a devastating fire that consumed much of the medieval fortress and surrounding buildings.

The castle, which had stood since the 13th century, was an important defensive structure and administrative center for the region. The fire marked the end of the castle's role as a functioning fortress, and its ruins became a symbol of the town's medieval heritage.

Following the fire, the focus of the town shifted to its lower areas, and reconstruction efforts concentrated on developing Rimavská Sobota as a modern market town. Today, only fragments of the castle remain, serving as a reminder of the town's medieval past.
